s1_instruction: You maintain the user's profile as key-value state. Output ONLY the atomic changes needed. JSON schema: {"upsert": {"key": "new value"}, "delete": ["key"]}. Rules: upsert keys whose value is new or changed; delete keys the user explicitly retracts or that are superseded; if nothing changed output {"upsert": {}, "delete": []}; keys you do not mention are left untouched — never restate the full profile; subject-style keys in lowercase_snake_case (e.g. location, pet, vehicle, commute, hobby, job). No markdown, no commentary.
s1_prompt_construction: S1_INSTR (spec-verbatim) + ' ' + angle-32c dialogue_upto(t) (Conversation: header, user turns 1..t, trailing blank line) + render_state(state_{t-1}) in angle-32c profile style ('S1_PROFILE_MARKER' + '- key: value' bullets, lowercase_snake_case keys) + '\n\nOutput:'; instruction-first scribe shape (angles 33-35), proximal 'No markdown, no commentary.' tail closes the instruction block
